unknowns: 连接被长期占用的具体原因（慢查询、长事务、未释放连接或锁等待）未证实；手册 pool-exhaustion--s02 与 db-lock-wait--s01 均指出仅凭池满日志不能认定泄漏或锁为根因
缺少连接持有时长、数据库会话（pg_stat_activity）、锁等待与调用栈数据

对比其他副本的 db_pool_active/db_pool_max/db_pool_waiters，确认影响范围是否限于 replica-2
核对同窗口下游依赖响应耗时与 HTTP 客户端池指标，排除 HTTP 池等待被误判为数据库池问题（参考 http-client-pool--s01）

tool_catalog.name: search_logs
tool_catalog.description:
Query logs in the current project. Times include timezone; interval is [start, end).

    Returns citeable evidence_id values. Limit is 1-200.

tool_catalog.name: query_metrics
tool_catalog.description:
Query metrics in the current project and [start_time, end_time).

    Leave metric_name unset to inspect available metrics. Returns citeable evidence. Limit is 1-300.

tool_catalog.name: search_runbooks
tool_catalog.description:
Search the current project's troubleshooting handbooks using symptoms and error terms.

    Use observed service/component names and error messages in query. Returns citeable chunk
    evidence_id, source, revision and content. Handbooks guide checks; they are not live telemetry.
    top_k is 1-10. Query is 1-2000 characters. Uses fixed BGE embeddings and pgvector cosine search.

tool_catalog.name: search_experiences
tool_catalog.description:
Find human-confirmed incident experience for a service in the current project.

    Use for related past incidents and applicable investigation steps. Results are historical
    knowledge, not live evidence for a new incident. Returns citeable IDs and original run/time.
    Exact service match, latest confirmations first. Limit is 1-20.

tool_catalog.name: analyze_logs
tool_catalog.description:
Run Python statistics on logs already retrieved in THIS run, using OpenShell only.

    Use only when the user requests statistical analysis. logs is a list of authorized rows.
    Print exactly one JSON value. No network, credentials, package installs or host files.
    Maximum 100 log IDs, code 6000 chars, 8 seconds, 256MiB, output 64KiB.
    Runtime absence is a tool error; never claim analysis succeeded without its result.

output.content: {"status":"diagnosed","cause_summary":"在 2026-11-02 09:00–09:15（+08:00）窗口内，order-api 的 replica-2 实例出现数据库连接池饱和：日志显示 HikariPool 获取连接等待 30000ms 后超时，active=20、idle=0、max=20；同一时间窗的指标显示 db_pool_active=21 已达到 db_pool_max=21，db_pool_waiters≈50.4 存在大量排队，http_5xx_ratio=0.38，说明连接池耗尽已造成约 38% 的 5xx 影响。按手册判定标准（active 达到 max、idle=0、waiters 上升，并结合同窗 5xx），可确认连接池饱和是本次异常的直接表现。但池满本身不能证明根因是连接泄漏、慢查询还是长事务/锁等待，这些尚未证实。","evidence_ids":["w6-pool-exhaustion-02-log-1","w6-pool-exhaustion-02-metric-1","w6-pool-exhaustion-02-metric-2","w6-pool-exhaustion-02-metric-3","w6-pool-exhaustion-02-metric-4","pool-exhaustion--s01","pool-exhaustion--s02","http-client-pool--s01","db-lock-wait--s01"],"unknowns":["连接被长期占用的具体原因（慢查询、长事务、未释放连接或锁等待）未证实；手册 pool-exhaustion--s02 与 db-lock-wait--s01 均指出仅凭池满日志不能认定泄漏或锁为根因","缺少连接持有时长、数据库会话（pg_stat_activity）、锁等待与调用栈数据","未确认是否只有 replica-2 受影响，其他副本的池指标未取得","未确认 5xx 的具体接口与业务影响范围，也未确认是否存在流量突增或近期变更","WARN 级别日志在该窗口为空，无法从告警日志侧补充线索","未查询同服务历史经验，历史结论不适用于本次现场判断"],"next_steps":["查询数据库侧 pg_stat_activity：会话状态、事务年龄、wait_event_type=Lock 及阻塞关系，区分慢查询/长事务/锁等待（参考 db-lock-wait--s01）","采集连接持有时长与获取连接的调用栈，判断是否存在连接未释放（参考 pool-exhaustion--s02）","对比其他副本的 db_pool_active/db_pool_max/db_pool_waiters，确认影响范围是否限于 replica-2","核对同窗口下游依赖响应耗时与 HTTP 客户端池指标，排除 HTTP 池等待被误判为数据库池问题（参考 http-client-pool--s01）","确认数据库剩余连接容量与实例规格后，再评估限流、回滚或调整池大小；未经容量验证不要直接扩大 max，任何生产变更需审批（参考 pool-exhaustion--s02）","检查该时段是否有发布、配置或流量变更，并统计 5xx 对应接口以量化影响"]}
